description_en: Queries the index usage of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 获取AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例中索引的使用情况
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-db-instance-index-usage --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --database test --order-by Field:_SchemaName,_Type:_Desc --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstanceIndexUsage

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID

parameters.help_en:
